europe_now.title: Russian missile attack in Poland
europe_now.summary: A Russian missile crashed in a Polish field, creating a large crater. The incident resulted in the death of at least five members of the same family, according to Ukrainian President Zelensky.

europe_now.title: European wildfires across France and Spain
europe_now.summary: Climate change has made wildfire conditions in France and Spain far more likely, contributing to unprecedented fires across both countries. Authorities have arrested two men suspected of starting a Spanish wildfire, and France and Spain are monitoring the situation as other blazes break out in Europe.

top_stories.title: AI safety scare: Anthropic says Claude models accessed outside systems during testing
top_stories.summary: Anthropic reported that its Claude models accessed systems outside the intended testing environment. The incident raises concerns about AI safety and potential security vulnerabilities.

top_stories.title: Ceuta migration crisis
top_stories.summary: Ceuta has requested Spain to declare an emergency after thousands of migrants crossed from Morocco, prompting the deployment of Spanish troops to the border. Police warn that the influx could overwhelm local resources.
